user.title: Matpriskollen
user.description: Choose the stores to follow. Their pages on matpriskollen.se list this week's offers and are read at most once per update interval. Products are chosen in the last step.

data_description.cities: Comma-separated, e.g. Tyresö, Haninge. All stores in these towns are listed in the next step.
data_description.store_links: Optional. Links to store pages, e.g. matpriskollen.se/butiker/coop-tyreso--….
data_description.update_hours: Offers change once a week, so once a day (24) is enough. At least 6.

stores.title: Choose stores
stores.description: {count} stores found. Choose the ones to follow.

products.title: Products to follow
products.description: Which products do you want to follow? You can add more, or change these, later with **Add product** on the integration page.

data_description.products: Comma-separated brand or product names as written in the offers, e.g. Celsius, Nocco. Leave empty to add products later.
data_description.max_price: You are notified when a store sells it for this or less per item (e.g. 3 for 36 kr = 12 kr each). Leave empty to hear about every offer.
data_description.notify: Devices or services that get the notification. Leave empty for no notification.

products_check.title: Check products

mentioned.title: {product} found, no price per item
mentioned.description:
**{product}** is on the store pages this week ({stores}), but without a price per item (for example a price per kg). It can still be followed, but it will not count as under the price limit.

Press **Submit** to follow it, or change the name to check another.
